summary: Practise obligation tracking, change control and supplier reviews for energy contracts. Explore the five-day course and outline.
lede: Oil and gas contract management is the coordinated control of energy agreements from award through closeout. For contract administrators, procurement professionals and project controls specialists, this intermediate training develops practical ways to map obligations, assess contract exposure and track milestones. You also practise recording changes, reviewing supplier performance and assembling traceable closeout records using contract extracts, registers and logs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who administer, monitor or advise on energy agreements and need consistent contract records across project and operating teams.
prerequisites: Prior exposure to contract administration, procurement, project controls or commercial work is expected. You should be able to read contract documents and follow basic project or supplier records. No coding or programming is required.
